name: 案件ごとの件数と日別合計を示す負荷の説明枠
prompt: Create a Japanese-localized version of the exact Asana task-count popover shown in the primary crop. This is a compact card about 411 × 160 px, around 2.57:1, with no surrounding page, toolbar, browser chrome, extra content, or large outside canvas. Preserve its white rounded card, thin light-gray outline and soft shadow, the small source pointer/notch along the top edge, and the original three-row hierarchy. Top row: preserve the exact small circular source portrait photo (do not substitute a generated avatar or icon), localize the date to 「12月25日」, and on the right use the pale gray rounded badge with a circled check icon and 「作業数」. Middle row: a small blue rounded-square project marker, the Japanese project label 「商品紹介の案件」 from the mock, and the right-aligned value 「1」. Add the same thin horizontal divider. Bottom row: 「一日の合計」 on the left and the right-aligned value 「1」. Keep generous but compact row padding, correct alignment, source-sized Japanese UI text in regular Meiryo style, black/dark gray labels, blue project marker, white canvas and neutral gray badge/divider. Do not add dates, names, values, icons, or actions that are not visible. The primary source controls the portrait, artwork, colors, card geometry and numbers; the Japanese mock supplies localized wording only. This is a raster candidate; do not imply native editability or app behavior.
reviewNotes: Compared with the complete original Asana screen, 3x source crop, and Japanese mock. The panel retains the visible source portrait, localized date 12月25日, checked 作業数 badge, blue project marker, localized project label 商品紹介の案件, project count 1, divider, and 一日の合計 1. Card structure, top pointer, relative spacing and white/neutral palette match closely; generated dimensions are 2009x783, essentially the source crop ratio 411x160. Pixel identity of the portrait and exact font/icon stroke metrics are not proven. Agent-reviewed raster candidate only; native editability and application behavior are unverified.
